about: What Orc promises a theme. Removing or renaming anything here is a breaking change: it needs a "Theme changes" entry in distribution/CHANGELOG.md and a higher apiVersion. bin/orc-theme-surface checks both. A theme's own names start with its id (--<id>-…, .<id>-…, #<id>-…) and are never Orc's.
